Topic / Section: Allocation of Seats
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 4)
Selection Categories:
  - OC
  - BC
  - BCM
  - MBC & DNC
  - SC
  - SCA
  - ST
Rule Of Reservation:
  Oc: 31.00%
  Bc: 26.50%
  Bcm: 3.50%
  Mbc & Dnc: 20.00%
  Sc: 15.00%
  Sca: 3.00%
  St: 1.00%
  Total: 100%

Topic / Section: Tuition Fee Concession
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 11)
Government School 7 5 Percent Reservation:
  Fee Waiver:
    - Counselling fee
    - Tuition fee
    - Hostel fee
  Government School Study Required: Sixth Standard to Twelfth Standard
  Eligible School Categories:
    - Government Schools
    - Corporation Schools
    - Municipal Schools
    - AdiDravida And Tribal Welfare Schools
    - Kallar Reclamation Schools
    - Forest Department Schools
    - Schools Managed by Government Departments
First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession:
  Eligible For:
    - Candidates who are the first graduate in a family
    - Candidates attending counselling and joining professional courses
  College Types:
    - Government Colleges
    - Aided Colleges
    - Self-Financing Colleges
Aicte Tuition Fee Waiver:
  Applicable To:
    - Self-Financing Engineering Colleges
    - Self-Supporting courses in Government Aided Engineering Colleges
  Courses:
    - B.E.
    - B.Tech.
  Maximum Seats: 5% of sanctioned intake per course
  Parent Annual Income Limit: Less than Rs.8,00,000
  Other Fees: All other fees except tuition fee must be paid by the candidate
Post Matric Scholarship:
  Eligible Categories:
    - SC
    - SCA
    - ST
    - SC/SCA converted Christians
  Parent Annual Income Limit: Less than Rs.2,50,000
  Requirement: Income certificate from appropriate authorities

Topic / Section: Procedure for Registration of Application
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 12)
Application Mode: Online
Admission System: TNEA 2026
Application Portals:
  - www.tneaonline.org
  - www.dte.tn.gov.in
Registration Requirements:
  - Mobile phone number
  - E-mail ID
  - 10th Marksheet
  - +2 Marksheet
  - School details from 6th to 12th standards
  - Community/Caste details
  - Aadhaar card
  - Parent annual income details
  - Payment details
Special Reservation Options:
  - 7.5% reservation for Government School Students
  - Son/Daughter of Ex-servicemen
  - Differently abled persons
  - Eminent sportsperson
Fee Concession Options:
  - First graduation Fee concession
  - Post-matric scholarship
Registration Fee:
  Oc/Bc/Bcm/Mbc&Dnc: Rs. 500
  Sc/Sca/St: Rs. 250

Topic / Section: Uploading Copy of Original Certificates
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 13)
Required Certificates:
  - 10th Marksheet
  - HSC First Year (+1) Marksheet
  - HSC Second Year (+2) / Equivalent Marksheet
  - Transfer Certificate
Reservation And Category Certificates:
  - Government school study details from 6th to 12th standard for 7.5% Government School Students Reservation
  - Permanent Community Certificate for ST, SC, SCA, MBC&DNC, BC and BCM
Conditional Certificates:
  - Nativity Certificate
  - Income Certificate
  - First Graduate Certificate
  - First Graduate Joint Declaration
  - Srilankan Tamil Refugee Certificate
Special Reservation Certificates:
  Son Or Daughter Of Ex Servicemen:
    - Parent's Discharge Certificate
    - Parent's ID Card
  Differently Abled Persons:
    - Medical Certificate obtained from Medical Board
  Eminent Sports Persons:
    - Sports achievement certificates
    - Necessary forms

Topic / Section: Online Choice Filling and Confirmation
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 13)
Merit List:
  Subjects:
    - Mathematics
    - Physics
    - Chemistry
  Maximum Marks: 200
  Mark Distribution:
    Mathematics: 100
    Physics: 50
    Chemistry: 50
  Ranking:
    - Overall rank
    - Community rank
Counselling:
  Mode: Online
  Number Of Rounds: Multiple rounds
  Participation: Candidates participate according to their rank
  Login Required: True
Online Counselling Procedure:
  Stages:
    - Choice Filling
    - Tentative Allotment
    - Confirmation of Tentative Allotment
    - Final Allotment
Choice Filling:
  Description: Candidates select and arrange their preferred colleges and branches in order of preference.
Allotment:
  Tentative Allotment: Candidates are provided a tentative seat allotment based on their choices and rank.
  Confirmation: Candidates must confirm the tentative allotment according to the prescribed procedure.
  Final Allotment: Final allotment is published after confirmation.

Topic / Section: Counselling Allotment and Confirmation
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 14)
Counselling Stages:
  - Choice Filling
  - Allotment
  - Confirmation of Allotment
  - Reporting to College/TFC and payment of fees
Choice Filling:
  Duration: Two or three days
  Description: Candidates fill their preferred colleges and branches in order of preference.
  Number Of Choices: Any number of choices
Allotment:
  Based On:
    - Candidate rank
    - Community
    - Availability of seats
    - Order of choices
Confirmation Options:
  - Accept and Join
  - Accept and Upward
  - Decline and Move to Next Round
  - Decline and Quit
Reporting:
  Accept And Join: Candidate must report to the allotted college and complete admission by paying the required fees.
  Accept And Upward: Candidate must report to the nearest TFC, pay the required fees and wait for upward movement.
Important Rule: Non-reporting or non-payment of required fees may result in cancellation of the allotment.

Topic / Section: Special Reservation Categories
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 15)
Eligibility: Only Tamil Nadu Native candidates are eligible for Special Reservation
Categories:
  Son Or Daughter Of Ex Servicemen:
    Seat Quota: 1 seat
    Applicable Colleges: Stand-alone Self-Financing Colleges
  Persons With Benchmark Disabilities:
    Seat Quota: 5% of seats
  Eminent Sports Persons:
    Seat Quota: 6 seats
    Seat Distribution:
      University Department: 1 seat
      Stand Alone Self Financing College: 5 seats
Important Conditions:
  - Candidates must produce appropriate certificates and supporting documents.
  - If required certificates and documents are not produced, the special reservation claim will not be considered.
  - Candidates under special reservation must also satisfy the general eligibility rules.
  - Candidates under special reservation are also eligible for admission under general counselling.
Certificate Requirements:
  Ex Servicemen:
    - Certificate from the Department of Ex-servicemen's Welfare of Tamil Nadu
    - Parent's Discharge Certificate
    - Parent's Ex-Servicemen ID Card
  Persons With Benchmark Disabilities:
    - Medical Certificate from the District Medical Board
    - Medical Board must consist of at least 3 doctors
  Eminent Sports Persons:
    - Original sports achievement certificates
    - Required forms specified in the brochure

Topic / Section: Course Specific Requirements
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 3)
Course: Marine Engineering
Academic Requirements:
  Qualification: 10+2 or equivalent
  Subjects:
    - Physics
    - Chemistry
    - Mathematics
    - English
  Minimum Average In Pcm: 60%
  Minimum English Marks: 50%
Entrance Exam: IMU CET
Age Limit: Maximum 25 years
Physical Requirements:
  Minimum Height: 157 cm
  Minimum Weight: 48 kg
  Colour Vision: Normal colour vision required
Medical Requirement: Physical fitness certificate as prescribed

Topic / Section: Course Specific Requirements
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 3)
Course: Mining Engineering
Female Candidates:
  Requirements:
    - As per Mines Act 1952, women cannot be employed in any part of a mine below ground.
    - In mines above ground, women cannot be employed except between 6 A.M. and 7 P.M.
    - As per Coal Mines Regulation 1957, women cannot descend or ascend a shaft in a cage or other means of conveyance unless accompanied by one or more adult males.
    - Candidates must satisfy the academic norms of Anna University.

Topic / Section: General Eligibility Rules
Source: TNEA Information Brochure 2026 (Page 2)
Eligibility Condition: Candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions as on the last date of submission of the online application.
Nativity:
  Tamil Nadu Candidates:
    - Candidates who have passed VIII, IX, X, XI and XII standard from schools situated in Tamil Nadu are eligible.
    - They need not produce a Nativity Certificate for verification.
  Tamil Nadu Native Outside Tamil Nadu Schooling:
    - Tamil Nadu native candidates who have passed any of VIII, IX, X, XI or XII standard from schools outside Tamil Nadu are eligible.
    - They must produce a digitally signed electronic Nativity Certificate.
  Central Government Employees Children:
    Eligibility: Children of Central Government Employees can apply irrespective of native place.
    Condition: Parent or guardian must have been serving continuously in Tamil Nadu for the past 5 years at the time of application.
    Proof: Certificate from the employer of the parent or guardian.
  Public Sector Or Government Recognised Institution Employees Children:
    Eligibility: Children of employees working in Tamil Nadu can apply irrespective of domicile.
    Condition: Parent must have been employed continuously in Tamil Nadu for the past 5 years.
    Proof:
      - Employer certificate confirming permanent employment
      - Income Tax return
      - PF slips or other supporting evidence
  All India Service Tamil Nadu Cadre Officers Children:
    Eligibility: Sons and daughters of All India Service officers belonging to Tamil Nadu cadre are eligible.
    Proof: Self-declaration from the parent.
  Other State Candidates:
    Eligibility: Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII standard in Tamil Nadu are eligible.
    Nativity Certificate: Not required
